user.title: Connect Nuvio catalogs
user.description: Enter one Stremio-compatible addon manifest URL per line.

data_description.package_name: Use com.nuvio.app for Play Store builds or com.nuvio.tv for most GitHub/sideload builds.
data_description.profile_id: Profile 1 is the primary profile. Use 2–5 for another profile.
data_description.connect_account: Adds Continue Watching, My Library, profiles, and synchronized addons.
data_description.debrid_provider: Used to turn torrent/debrid results into directly playable HTTP file links.
data_description.debrid_api_key: Stored locally in Home Assistant's config entry. Nuvio does not sync debrid credentials with your account.

reconfigure.title: Nuvio account
reconfigure.description: Connect, reconnect, or disconnect your Nuvio account and select the profile used by Home Assistant.

data_description.profile_id: Profile 1 is the primary profile. Use 2–5 for another profile.
data_description.connect_account: Turn this off to disconnect the currently linked Nuvio account.
data_description.debrid_provider: Select the provider Home Assistant should use when resolving file links.
data_description.debrid_api_key: Leave blank to keep the current key when the provider is unchanged. Nuvio does not sync these credentials.

device.title: Authorize Nuvio
device.description: Scan the QR code or open [Nuvio authorization]({url}), approve code **{code}**, then return here and select **Submit**.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load any addon manifest
error.invalid_url: Enter at least one valid http or https manifest URL
error.login_start_failed: Could not start Nuvio account authorization
error.login_pending: Nuvio has not approved this code yet. Authorize it and try Continue again.
error.login_connection_failed: Could not check the Nuvio authorization. Check the connection and try again.
error.debrid_key_required: Enter an API key/token for the selected debrid provider.

abort.login_failed: Nuvio authorization failed or expired; start setup again
